title: Jabba The Hutt
description: Jabba the Hutt's palace on Tatooine was the base of operations for his criminal concerns. A larger-than-life figure on the desert planet, Jabba the Hutt appeared at events like the Boonta Eve Podrace and kicked off the race with aplomb. His business in the underworld was vast and he even served on the Hutt Grand Council, helping oversee the criminal activities of all the Hutt clans, not just his own. As the Clone Wars began, the Hutt's control of hyperspace lanes made Jabba even more powerful, and he was often courted by members of the Republic and Separatists alike.
